items.title: Catch Me If You Can – CANCELLED
items.detail_title: Catch Me If You Can – CANCELLED
items.overview: Catch Me If You Can (2002) is a biographical crime comedy-drama starring Leonardo DiCaprio and Tom Hanks. Based on the story of Frank Abagnale Jr., a teenage con artist who poses as a pilot, doctor and lawyer to pull off million-dollar scams, the film follows an FBI agent determined to catch him in a thrilling game of cat and mouse.

items.title: Love Actually – Kirstenbosch
items.overview: Five weeks before Christmas marks the start of the festive countdown — the perfect time to cosy up with a Christmas classic. Join us for Love Actually , a heartwarming rom-com-drama featuring a beloved British ensemble cast. Filmed mostly in London, the story weaves together ten interconnected tales exploring the many forms of love, unfolding in a countdown to Christmas.

items.title: Pretty Woman
items.overview: Pretty Woman is a 1990 romantic comedy film. Rich corporate raider from New York (Richard Gere) needs an escort for some social events, and hires a beautiful prostitute (Julia Roberts)… only to fall in love.

items.title: Rush Hour
items.overview: Rush Hour is a 1998 American buddy cop action comedy film. It stars Jackie Chan, Chris Tucker, Tom Wilkinson, Chris Penn and Elizabeth Peña. In the film a loyal and dedicated Hong Kong Inspector (Chan) teams up with a reckless and loudmouthed LAPD detective (Tucker) to rescue the Chinese Consul’s kidnapped daughter, while trying to arrest a dangerous crime lord along the way.

items.title: Sinners
items.age_restriction: 16 D H L P S V
items.overview: Sinners is a 2025 horror film written and directed by Ryan Coogler. Set in 1932 in the Mississippi Delta, it stars Michael B. Jordan in dual roles as twin brothers who return to their hometown, hoping to leave their troubled lives behind, only to discover an even greater evil waiting for them. The film co-stars Hailee Steinfeld, Miles Caton, Jack O’Connell and Wunmi Mosaku.

items.title: Grease
items.overview: Grease is a classic musical rom-com that unfolds the 1958 summer romance of T-Bird greaser – Danny and good girl – Australian transfer student Sandy. The film stars John Travolta and Olivia Newton-John as Danny and Sandy.

items.title: It’s Complicated
items.overview: It’s Complicated is a 2009 American romantic comedy film. It stars Meryl Streep as a bakery owner and single mother of three who starts a secret affair with her ex-husband, played by Alec Baldwin, ten years after their divorce – only to find herself drawn to another manh her architect, Adam (portrayed by Steve Martin).
